doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Thanks and talk of a second session
summary: They thank each other and Rowe suggests a round two.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well thanks for coming out here today.
And we may have to do round two.
Oh really? I enjoyed it very much. It’s good to reminisce when somebody can prompt you, and you did great. You sure made me bring out some memories.
